 Live .  23,743 viewing 23743 viewing Sri Lanka hit six to win thrilling ODI against England
 Thu 22 Oct 2026 , Men's One Day International Series Sri Lanka vs England, result Sri Lanka Sri Lanka Result England England 430 -8 ( 49.5 ) 429 -4 ( 50.0 ) Sri Lanka   win by 2 wickets Sri Lanka innings: 430 for 8 from 49.5 overs
 England innings: 429 for 4 from 50.0 overs
 Sri Lanka make 430 to beat England after Brook's 202 
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scorecard 
 Summary
 Sri Lanka complete second-highest chase in ODI history
 Victory sealed with a six after Tongue takes two in two 
 Rathnayake's 130 lays foundations after England pile up 429-4
 Earlier, Brook becomes first Englishman to hit 200 in ODIs
 Skipper beats England record for ODI high score held by Ben Stokes (182 v NZ, 2023)
 Brook also the fastest to 200 in all ODIs 
 Close form Have your say on England men this winter

 by Ffion Wynne
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:33 BST 17:33 BST

 Magnificent chase from Sri Lanka but that has to be one of the most inept English bowling performances of all time, across all formats. Embarrassing defeat despite the brilliance of the Sri Lankan batters.
 David, Maltby 
 Absolutely dreadful performance by England in the field but very well done to Sri Lanka for the chase.
 Richard, Dorset

 It was clearly an absolutely belting pitch to bat on, and the boundaries were pretty small. Still, England's bowling is a concern and they weren't great in the field either (they are without Jofra Archer, of course).

 Post published at 17:29 BST 17:29 BST 
 Steven Finn 
Former England fast bowler on BBC Test Match Special 
 Staggering. Who would be a bowler? What a crazy pitch for batting on. The bounce was true. The ball came onto the bat the entire day and it just seemed to get better and better as the floodlights came on.
 Sri Lanka read those conditions perfectly. They wouldn't have liked to chase as many as they did but they backed themselves to chase down whatever England set them and they did it in remarkable fashion.
 64 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How Sri Lanka's chase unfolded published at 17:26 BST 17:26 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 Chasing 430, both Sri Lanka openers fall inside the powerplay before Avishka Fernando and Pavan Rathnayake recover with a composed stand of 166. 
 Avishka falls for 97 but Rathnayake kicks on to a majestic century, adding a fantastic partnership of 133 off just 79 balls with Dasun Shanaka. 
 They both fall in quick succession by the end of the 44th over, Rathnayake for 130 and Shanaka for 97. Sri Lanka still need 67 off the last six overs. 
 But Janith Liyanage plays a gem of an innings, despite the loss of two wickets in the final over, hitting the winning runs with a six to finish 61 not out off just 27 balls.

 Despite a challenging last decade of being a Sri Lanka fan, the team does find a way to give you the odd mad moment of joy. Incredible scenes.
 Raji, Wallingford 
 269 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:22 BST 17:22 BST 
 Alex Hartley 
Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 There have not been many times when I have not got much to say other than wow. That whole game of cricket was just wow.
 Harry Brook has scored 200. England got 429 and they have lost. There were two batters for Sri Lanka who were both dismissed for 97. They had one man score 130. It's been a game where it's had it all.
 England have been sloppy at times but Sri Lanka were sloppy at times. It really has been a game of absolutely everything out there today and I cannot believe England have lost.
